name: local-helper-ownership
goal: Every existing single-consumer helper lives beside its owning component, service or function while shared helpers, contracts and registered history remain intact.

evidence: Relocate all 412 baseline single-consumer helpers into owner-local folders. Preserve 392 shared helpers, implementation semantics, stable registered identities and source/history evidence. Migration ledger names each helper and owner.

Existing unit-index relocation coverage proves synthetic moves and identity retention but does not check the actual repository helper layout. Extend that standardized suite with the committed migration ledger, definition fingerprints and owner-folder assertions.
Corrected test-only commit 7c6d3e74 fails all 411 missing owner-local definitions. Record 6bd8dbaf7702f0d4def2518d67c934f264229bf45f53ab3480ac8617e7ee2894 freezes both the test and migration ledger.

Confirmed private definitions and their supporting declarations move beside terminal owners. Mixed modules keep shared implementations available, registered identities remain unchanged, and temporary forwarding modules preserve frozen regression inputs until proof is recorded.
